SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME , TARGET AS TARGET , KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO , KEY_2 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , KEY_3 AS LEGACY_GR_NO , KEY_4 AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ FROM APPS.KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME IN ('GR','GRD') AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY DOC_NAME, KEY_1, KEY_2
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'SMT2' AS BUYER , 'KA' AS SITE , PLANT , LEGACY_PO_NO , LEGACY_PO_SEQ , DECODE(STATUS,'APPROVED','C','D') AS STATUS , BUYER_ITEM_NO , UNIT_PRICE , GR_QTY , GR_AMT , TO_CHAR(GR_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS GR_DATE , LEGACY_PR_NO , LEGACY_RG_NO AS LEGACY_GR_NO , LEGACY_RG_SEQ AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ , RO_QTY , RO_AMT , REMARK , LEGACY_RG_NO2 FROM APPS.V_KEP_GR WHERE LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = $G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$ AND LEGACY_RG_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND LEGACY_RG_SEQ = $G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$ ORDER BY LEGACY_GR_NO, LEGACY_GR_SEQ, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ
UPDATE APPS.KEPTRXL SET KEY_6 = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') , IF_FLAG = 'Y' WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.TARGET$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND KEY_4 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
